author: Capt_oj
body:
MY username is Capt_oj. I have been ban once for greefing and i waited my time out. This time i was banned for (flying/ aim bot) I did not know why i was banned but it said a time 8:21 and on my clock it was 4:21. I waited until 8 but then i relised that this was a permanent ban. I was not flying or anything. I look up why i could have been ban for this. It said if i was on laggy wifi it might seem as if i and teleporting or flying. I think this was a mistake. I was banned by vobaseball12. I don't know if he has had any false reports before. I understand if i still need a punishment but please let me back on your server. No other servers have nebula.

Sincerely,
Cam

Sorry about the other one i  did not know what Archive meant
